items.rationale: The diagnostic shows 41,200 mWh against a design capacity of 52,000 mWh (79.2%). With no battery-health waiver, clauses 2.6.8 and 2.6.7 bar reimbursement under 5.2.3 even though the inspection established the exclusion; €65 gross is the estimate if covered, below the €250 cap.

items.description: Laptop screen and lower-right corner repair
items.rationale: The swerve and impact qualify under 2.6.2, but the measured battery capacity is below 80% and no waiver applies, so 2.6.8 excludes the entire laptop, not just its battery. If covered, the pictured €549 parts-and-labour quote supports the gross estimate for the combined repair under 7.1.10.
